description: This file defines a PHP trait 'JsonParserTrait' that provides JSON error parsing functionality for AWS API responses, particularly handling error codes, types, and structured JSON payload parsing.

methods.name: genericHandler
methods.description: Handles an HTTP response to extract error information such as error code, type, request ID, and parsed JSON payload.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the JSON body of the response and applies the parser to a StructureShape object, if JSON is present.
